clips.title: The story
paras: Grunt Logmar is an orc warrior of the Horde stationed in the southern Barrens at Camp Taurajo. Dutiful and vigilant, he monitors threats surrounding the camp and coordinates efforts to locate and aid missing Horde scouts in the region.

Stationed among the tauren at Camp Taurajo, Grunt Logmar serves as a watchful orc guard on the southern Barrens frontier. The settlement sits close to hostile quilboar grounds and the mountain passes leading into Stonetalon and Mulgore, requiring constant vigilance. Logmar coordinates scouting reports and reaches out to capable Horde travelers when his comrades find themselves ambushed or captured by local hostiles.
